derivation: For every unordered three-dimension base key, generate each of its six unique permutations. The first ordered dimension is the first activity prompt; the second and third are supporting prompts. The order changes exploration sequence only, never identity, ability, career fit, or recommendation.
coverage_assertion: 20 unordered bases x 6 permutations = 120 ordered codes; no additional reader-copy asset is created for an ordered permutation.
